source_text: Plena omnis terra gloria eius. Olim domus plena erat gloria; nunc omnis terra. Elevatum est superliminare a voce clamantium; domus impleta est fumo.
pass_a_gloss: The whole earth is full of his glory. Once the house was full of glory; now the whole earth. The lintel was raised by the voice of those crying; the house was filled with smoke.
pass_b_english: [[The whole earth is full of his glory >> Bible:Isaiah 6:3]] — not only the temple house. [[The thresholds shook at the voice of those who called, and the house was filled with smoke >> Bible:Isaiah 6:4]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Isaiah homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
